submittedParameters.prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve. ONE original native transparent RGBA game sprite, square 1280x1280 or greater: 06 thunder caster boy run E10 LOW PASSING phase.
Image1 identity, image2 pure E side camera, image3 approved painting. Image4 is EDIT TARGET E09 compressed support. Image5 E11 is next-pose continuity reference only.
Create one NEW pose between image4 and image5. Keep image4's compressed body height and head size exactly. LOW PASSING MUST STAY LOW: top of ponytail same y as image4 (about .12 canvas), face/shoulders/body remain low. Do not stretch the boy upward or enlarge head. Same pure SCREEN RIGHT profile, round child face and one amber eye.
LEFT far planted boot stays at SAME pixel ground height as image4, ankle x=.57 y=.90, heel/sole y=.92. Left supporting knee remains deeply flexed, no straight upright stance. RIGHT near knee swings FORWARD under pelvis toward screen right, near thigh passes visibly IN FRONT of left thigh; right shin folds back with raised boot just behind/above supporting ankle at x=.48,y=.82. Exactly two normal knees, ankles and boots. Retain leg lengths and white crossed wraps.
Arm transition: anatomical RIGHT near hand holds short golden pointed thunder wand, elbow beside waist, wrist by RIGHT SIDE RIBS not chest, wand head angled upward near x=.57,y=.46. The right shoulder is beginning its backward swing, neither full-forward nor full-back. Anatomical LEFT far arm brings rectangular gold plaque from behind to FRONT near chest, LEFT hand holding plaque at x=.69,y=.60. Exactly TWO arms and TWO hands, one prop each; NO extra fist on chest and no third sleeve. Shoulders/elbows connect naturally. No mirrored swaps.
Preserve brown high ponytail, gold ribbon/teal beads, ivory/gold embroidered navy-lined short coat, lightning trousers, black-gold boots. Same soft bright hand-painted finish. Root x=.50, ground y=.92, no pixels below .935. Background truly transparent, no floor/shadow/effects/beam/text/checkerboard/grid. Do not copy same pose, do not lengthen body. Target GPT Image 2.5 Sunburst/max; actual host selectors unavailable.

visualReview: 恢复输出初审：压低承重高度、两手持物及肩肘中间位改善，腿脚可辨；相位与完整动态仍待复审。此调用结果回执丢失，由本代理独占宿主生成目录时戳和图像内容匹配恢复，时间为提交时间。
